title: The Fishing Derby Trophy
story: At dawn on derby day, four anglers cast their lines from the town pier, and each landed one fish of a different kind and a different length before the noon horn. Otis measured every catch, whistling a shanty off-key, then wrote the lengths on a tide chart that the wind carried straight into the harbor. The trophy goes to the longest fish. Who caught what, and who takes the trophy home?

trace.text: Clue 2 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).

The bluefish must go with 18 inches: clue 2 rules out 12 inches and 14 inches; clue 5 rules out 16 inches.
Since the mackerel can still be only 12 inches, 14 inches, or 16 inches, clue 1 means Oscar cannot be 12 inches.
Since Oscar can still be only 14 inches, 16 inches, or 18 inches, clue 3 means Cyrus cannot be 18 inches.

Since Oscar can still be only 14 inches, 16 inches, or 18 inches and Elsa can still be only 12 inches, 14 inches, or 16 inches, clue 6 means Oscar cannot be 16 inches or 18 inches and Elsa cannot be 12 inches or 14 inches.
Elsa must go with 16 inches: clue 6 rules out 12 inches and 14 inches; 18 inches is already ruled out for the bluefish.
Oscar must go with 14 inches: clue 1 rules out 12 inches; clue 6 rules out 16 inches and 18 inches.
Cyrus must go with 12 inches: clue 3 rules out 18 inches; the other choices are already taken.
Nico must go with 18 inches: the other choices are already taken.
The bluefish goes with 18 inches, so the bluefish also goes with Nico.
The mackerel must go with Cyrus: clue 4 rules out Elsa; clue 1 rules out Oscar; Nico already goes with the bluefish.
Elsa must go with the flounder: clue 4 rules out the bluefish and the mackerel; the scup is already ruled out for 16 inches.
Oscar must go with the scup: clue 1 rules out the mackerel; the other choices are already taken.
16 inches must go with the flounder: clue 5 rules out the scup and the bluefish; the mackerel is already ruled out for Elsa.
14 inches goes with Oscar, so 14 inches also goes with the scup.
The mackerel must go with 12 inches: 16 inches is already ruled out for Elsa; the other choices are already taken.
